claims.claim: Mirror Lake, NH, 3-year annual mean zooplankton biomass 1.4–2.6 kg C/ha
claims.location: p. 109 (PDF p. 2), abstract; p. 123 (PDF p. 16), text and Table 14
claims.quote: The annual zooplankton biomass ranged from 1.4 to 2.6 kg C/ha
claims.conditions: whole-lake annual mean biomass for October–September years 1968–69, 1969–70, 1970–71: 2.03, 2.58 and 1.37 kg C/ha (3-yr mean 2.0); water-bottle samples at 0, 3, 6 and 9 m (11.88 L, after May 1970 2.97 L) weekly in the open season and monthly otherwise; oligotrophic, usually dimictic, mean depth 5.75 m, residence 1.0 yr
claims.note: The '1.4–2.6' is the range of the three annual means, not a seasonal range.

claims.claim: copepods 55.4 %, cladocerans 28.3 % and rotifers 16.3 % (§3.3.8: 16 %) of zooplankton biomass
claims.location: p. 123 (PDF p. 16), Table 14 (read on the page image)
claims.conditions: 3-yr mean of each year's percentage, carbon basis, whole lake; columns Rotifera, Cladocera, Copepoda

claims.claim: copepods 19.3 % and rotifers 39.8 % of zooplankton production
claims.location: p. 109 (PDF p. 2), abstract; p. 123 (PDF p. 16), Table 14
claims.quote: represent only 19.3% of the zooplankton production, while rotifers account for 39.8%
claims.conditions: 3-yr mean percentages of annual production (carbon); total production 22.3–29.3 kg C ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹; cladocerans 40.9 %

claims.location: mean depth p. 109 (PDF p. 2); biomass and shares p. 123 (PDF p. 16), Table 14; carbon content p. 119 (PDF p. 12), Table 9
claims.conditions: annual (all-season) whole-lake mean, not a summer value
claims.note: 2.0 kg C/ha = 0.20 g C/m² ÷ 5.75 m = 34.8 µg C/L of all zooplankton; crustaceans (28.3 + 55.4 = 83.7 %) = 29.1 µg C/L; at 48 % C of dry weight = 60.6 µg DW/L, so ≈ 60 holds for crustaceans at that assumed carbon fraction. The article's own measured crustacean carbon contents (Table 9: Holopedium 38.0, Cyclops 41.8, Daphnia catawba 47.1, Diaptomus 51.7 % of DW) give 56–77 µg DW/L (≈ 65 at their mean, 44.7 %). All zooplankton at 48 % C would be ≈ 73 µg DW/L. The table's caption calls the rows 'Summer zooplankton'; this row is an annual mean, which its label does say.

notes: Other values: rotifer generation time ~8–10 d at 17 °C (cultured); respiration 79.9 % of assimilation; the 0–4.5-m stratum held 46.5 % of biomass and 68.5 % of production; daily P/B in May–September 0.04 for crustaceans and 0.11 for rotifers; annual P/B of the community 10.1 (Table 16); rotifers took 33.5 % of the P incorporated by zooplankton with an annual P turnover of 30.9 (crustaceans 10.1). Mirror Lake's five fishes are yellow perch, chain pickerel, brown bullhead, white sucker and smallmouth bass — the Hot Brook set, which makes it a good analog. Routine samples were water-bottle samples (11.88 L, later 2.97 L, at 0, 3, 6 and 9 m) filtered on the lake; a comparison of devices used 158-µm nets and a plankton funnel with 35-µm mesh, and the water bottle caught more of the larger cladocerans and copepods (p. 110).
